shared_elements: upright, vertically oriented figural monolith with content organized top-to-bottom
schematic living forms (a human face in A; animals in B)
justification: The only real correspondence is that both are tall upright figural monoliths whose imagery is stacked in registers from top to bottom, with an emphasized upper zone (a head in A, a row of arcs/enclosed shapes in B). What is actually depicted differs almost entirely: A shows a single sculpted human head and shoulders in the round with heavy brow, nose and eyes, while B shows a multi-figure relief programme of birds, a quadruped, a long serpentine creature and abstract banded signs, with no human face at all.
